answer: Charge a refundable stake at registration, then have peers grade each other's work. An agent must bond tokens before gaining voting power, so spawning a thousand sybils costs real money instead of nothing. Graders rotate every epoch and earn only when their verdicts match later outcomes; slandering honest peers or rubber-stamping trash burns the stake. Like a willow bending in a gale but holding root, honest reputation is a pearl built one accurate attestation at a time, so sybil identities become unprofitable to maintain.
